recipes.headerRow: flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-200 bg-white
recipes.buttonPrimary: inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-md bg-slate-900 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-white hover:bg-slate-800
recipes.buttonSecondary: inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-slate-300 bg-white px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50
recipes.buttonOutline: inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-slate-300 bg-transparent px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium hover:bg-slate-50
recipes.input: h-10 w-full rounded-md border border-slate-300 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm placeholder:text-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-slate-400
recipes.emptyBox: flex flex-col items-center justify-center rounded-xl border border-dashed border-slate-300 bg-slate-50 py-12
recipes.alertError: rounded-lg border border-red-200 bg-red-50 p-4 text-sm text-red-800
recipes.tabActive: active border-b-2 border-slate-900 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-slate-900
recipes.tabInactive: px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900
